BiblicalUsage: Artaxerxes decrees that all who are minded of their own free will may go up to Jerusalem, and the king and his counsellors freely offer silver and gold to the God of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe free will in the Bible is never forced: the king opens the road and offers his gold freely, and the people go because they are minded to go, not because they are driven.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
